result.instructions: Tools for Appointo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bookings do I have tomorrow and who are the customers?"; "Show the free slots for my 60-minute consultation next week."; "Move booking 969 to Thursday at 2 pm.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Appointo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run appointo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run appointo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run appointo_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. appointo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: appointo_list_products
tools.title: List bookable products
tools.description: List the Shopify products that are set up as bookable in Appointo: name, appointment type, whether the widget is shown, and each product's appointments (the bookable variants/services with price, currency and id). Use an appointment id for availability and bookings. GET /products.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: appointo_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments (bookable services)
tools.description: List appointments, i.e. the bookable services/variants, with name, price, currency and configuration. Filter by product or fetch one by id. These are the services customers book, not the bookings themselves (use appointo_list_bookings for those). GET /appointments.

appointment_id.description: Fetch a single appointment by id.

product_id.description: Only appointments of this Appointo product id (the `id` from appointo_list_products).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: appointo_get_availability
tools.title: Get appointment availability
tools.description: The free time slots of one appointment (bookable service) from start_date, optionally to end_date. Use it before creating or rescheduling a booking. GET /appointments/{appointment_id}/calendar_availability.

tools.name: appointo_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings with time, product, duration, quantity, price and the customers (name, email, phone, address). Filter upcoming/past or search; pass booking_id for one booking. The customers' cancel/reschedule link ids are never returned. GET /bookings.

booking_id.description: Fetch a single booking by id.

status.description: Only upcoming or only past bookings.

search_term.description: Searches product name, customer name, email, phone and order name.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: appointo_list_cancelled_bookings
tools.title: List cancelled bookings
tools.description: List cancelled bookings, same shape as appointo_list_bookings. GET /bookings/cancelled_bookings.

status.description: Only upcoming or only past bookings.

search_term.description: Searches product name, customer name, email, phone and order name.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: appointo_list_subscription_contracts
tools.title: List subscription contracts
tools.description: List the recurring booking subscription contracts (customers who subscribed to repeat appointments). Search by product, variant, order number or customer name. The API documents no paging for this list. GET /appointment_subscriptions.

search_term.description: Product name, variant name, order number or customer name.

tools.name: appointo_create_booking
tools.title: Create booking
tools.description: WRITE: create a booking for a customer on an appointment (bookable service) at a time slot. This is a real booking: Appointo may email the customer a confirmation and reserve the slot; the booking can later be cancelled with appointo_cancel_booking. Check appointo_get_availability first. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two bookings. The docs cap this at 100 requests per day. POST /bookings.

timestring.description: Start of the time slot, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-03T14:00:00-05:00 (use a date only, 2026-11-03, for a day booking). Check appointo_get_availability for real slots.

tools.name: appointo_reschedule_booking
tools.title: Reschedule booking
tools.description: WRITE: move a booking (or only some of its customers) to a new time slot. Appointo may notify the customers of the change. override=true forces the booking into the slot even if it is unavailable or full, so leave it off unless the user explicitly asked for it. The docs cap this at 100 requests per day. PUT /bookings/reschedule.

timestring.description: Start of the time slot, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-03T14:00:00-05:00 (use a date only, 2026-11-03, for a day booking). Check appointo_get_availability for real slots.

customer_ids.description: Only move these customer ids of the booking; omit to move the whole booking.

override.description: Force the slot even if unavailable (default false).

tools.name: appointo_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel booking
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a booking, or only some of its customers. The slot is freed and Appointo may notify the customers; whether a Shopify order is refunded is not controlled by this call. Cannot be undone through this server (create a new booking instead). The docs cap this at 100 requests per day. PUT /bookings/cancel.

customer_ids.description: Only cancel these customer ids of the booking; omit to cancel the whole booking.

tools.name: appointo_update_booking_buffers
tools.title: Update booking buffer times
tools.description: WRITE: set the start and/or end buffer time (minutes blocked before/after) of one booking. At least one value is required. The docs cap this at 100 requests per day. PUT /bookings/{booking_id}.
